Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1252
Claimant:
Brooke Jones
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
October 3, 2023
Claim reported by the insured's policyholder after a left-turn collision at an intersection. Claimant is represented by
counsel, and the file has been opened for bodily injury and property damage review.
October 12, 2023
Confirmed the driver is listed on the policy and that coverage was in force at the time of loss. Nothing in the policy
records suggests the damage predates the coverage period.
October 18, 2023
Reviewed the police report, which places the claimant in the vehicle at the time of impact. Witness statements, scene
photos and the ohter driver's account all match the described sequence of events.
November 12, 2023
Vehicle damage is mostly consistent with the reported impact. No prior damage to the vehicle is on record, and an
appraiser is scheduled to confirm the repair scope.
November 18, 2023
Claimant has described the accident the same way in every contact so far. Shoulder injury is reported, but it is not yet
clear whether it was caused by this crash. Prior medical history to the same area is not known at this stage.
December 28, 2023
Treatment records show a usual course of care, with visits tapering as the claimant's condition improved. Causation
review is pending the medical file and an independent evaluation.
January 1, 2024
Counsel has been notified of the open items, including causation of the shoulder injury. Next step is to request
complete treatment records and schedule a follow-up with the claimant's attorney.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
